criteria.requirement: Initially request sufficient objects and update/merge method/options with observed output. Explain only what disclosed evidence supports; missing data alone cannot establish shallow replacement, default creation or a defect. insufficient_information is valid when reproduction cannot be supplied.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
